lead85_unit1_pooled_brier.classification_evidence: Nominee Brier primary remains unmeasured in adapter unit; no admissible closing ground. Zero crossing closes nothing.
lead85_unit1_pooled_brier.description: LEAD-85 unit 1: 20-node coefficient integration minus separately calibrated four-term point fit; chronological outer 2023-2025; ordinary opener diagnostics.
lead85_unit1_pooled_brier.notes: 713 predeclared study looks; two-arm ordinary-endpoint subset. 10000 paired season/week bootstrap draws; positive means candidate improvement. Previously examined archives; no served change. No split-half reliability measured.
lead85_unit1_pooled_brier.plain_summary: Allowing for uncertainty in the football estimates slightly improved the overall probability scores, but helped in two seasons and hurt in the third. The picks stayed the same; the weekly Best Pick comparison is still to come.
